editorial:
Imagine you and your friends head to a fancy wellness retreat in the middle of a thick German forest to relax and get healthy. That is exactly how things start for this group of American kids, but the vibe shifts fast. After a wild night of partying, they realize they are not alone in the woods. Something scary is stalking them, and the quiet nature of the retreat quickly turns into a nightmare. You will feel the tension build as the characters stop trusting each other and start wondering who or what is actually hunting them.

The acting feels real and the jumpscares actually work without being too cheesy. While the middle part of the story drags a little, the final act is a total ride with a twist you will not see coming. If you love scary movies that keep you guessing, you should definitely check this one out. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, so make sure to stream it that way for the best picture. Or, if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for those deep forest colors.
endingExplained: You find out that Loretta is not a ghost, but a local woman who was betrayed by the retreat owners years ago. She uses the forest to lure guests into traps. In the final scene, the main character escapes by tricking Loretta into a cellar and locking her inside. However, the very last shot shows another person wearing Loretta's mask, meaning the cycle of killing is not over yet.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves survival horror and shocking twists.
